# hg identity

**What this page tells you:** every `hg identity` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

The local identity provider's issuer, clients and users.

## Synopsis

```text
hg identity
```

`--json` prints one JSON document on stdout; narration goes to stderr.

## Description

Re-establishes the port-forward before reporting — it dies with every pod roll, and a status command that reports a dead issuer as configured is the same lie every other surface here refuses. Secrets live in `~/.hermes-gitops/identity-secrets.json` (0600) and are never printed.
